svg.title: Helper process workflow
svg.desc: The runtime checks the protocol v2 hello token and session. A matching probe result is published and enters ready with an idle work slot. Ordinary work is submitted afterward. The policy correlates work receipts by job ID and phase, and shutdown escalation follows the current deadline stage.

g.text: loop [submit, optional cancel, preview and final receipts]
spawn with session UUID and token
dispatch probe and clear startup deadline
publish probe result and enter ready with idle slot
submit after ready / cancel / correlated receipt
authorized frame(session, job) or transport pump
receipt for matching session and active job
escalate only when stage matches phase
settle probe or job, settle queue, clean up
